subject: Consolidated QBR asks & triage — week of Sep 4
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@deltacore.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated QBR asks & triage — week of Sep 4

Team — looping in the DeltaCore contacts so we have a shared source of truth for the outstanding asks ahead of the QBR. I pulled everything from this week’s sync and the ad-hoc asks channel; below are the priority items I want status on by end of week.

Action items (owner / ask / target):
1) SLA exception approval (Kimberly) — we need an approved exception template that allows the dedicated pool to have a 12hr incident response SLA for non-critical infra items. Exec ask from DeltaCore leadership; they want draft wording by EOD Thu so their legal can review before the QBR.
2) Model rollout gating checklist (Marissa) — provide a short bullet list of required testing (perf, regressions, privacy) and a recommended canary cadence. We want to surface any expected end-to-end blocker.
3) Procurement & contract cadence (Helen) — confirm DocuSign timeline and any procurement pre-reqs (billing contact, PO flow). DeltaCore requested a target signature date of Sep 18.
4) Runbook quick wins (Vivek) — list 2–3 ops guardrails we can ship before QBR that reduce paging noise (example: rate limit thresholds, cold-start diagnostics).

Attachments: QBR-ask-tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet) — I dropped the initial tracker in Drive and attached a copy. Also attached SLA-exception-draft.docx for Kimberly to iterate.

Please reply with short updates (one-liners) — if something needs escalation to execs, flag it and I’ll pull in Aditya.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Sean — quick status:
- Model rollout checklist: I exported the checklist as a one-page doc and added three gating tests: perf (95th p95 under target), regression evals (baseline pass rate > 97%), and privacy smoke (no PII leakage in canned prompts). I uploaded the checklist to the Drive folder and put a short summary in the tracker.
- Expected blockers: one perf regression on the 4k-context variant (we saw a 10% p95 increase in last run). I think that’s a 2-day engineering fix if we prioritize kernel selection.

Attaching: small attachment "model-rollout-checklist.pdf" in Drive (not attached to email)

Marissa

Final mini-plan (owner / due):

- Model gating & perf blocker: Marissa — schedule a 2-day kernel fix window and confirm readiness by Wed 2028-09-06 EOD. If not ready, propose rollback dates.
- Procurement details: Helen — confirm billing contact and PO template by Sep 07.
- Ops runbook quick wins: Vivek — list and ship 2 guardrails (rate-limit & cold-start diagnostic) by Sep 11.

I uploaded a consolidated tracker (QBR-ask-tracker.xlsx) to Drive and added the above owners/dates. Link in related_links. If anything changes, reply-all with a one-line update so execs have a single-threaded view.
